description: Searches Indeed for `query` in `location` and returns the job listings as JSON: `title`, `company`, `location`, `salary` (with parsed `min`/`max`), `jobTypes`, `companyRating`, a `snippet`, `datePosted` (YYYY-MM-DD), `sponsored` (Indeed's paid placement) and a clean job `url`. Filter with `country`, `job_type`, `days` (posting age), `remote`, sort with `sort` (`date` returns the collected jobs newest first, sponsored ones included), and collect up to `max_results` across pages. Indeed sits behind Cloudflare + PerimeterX - handled for you. Returns JSON. Billed like an API request; listing plugins bill one unit per result page they fetch, so keep max_results modest.

country.description: Indeed country site: us, uk, ca, au, in, ie, de, fr, nl, es, it, at, ch, be, pl, se, sg, za, nz, mx. Default: us.

job_type.description: Job type: fulltime, parttime, contract, internship, temporary.

max_results.description: How many jobs to collect across pages. Default: 30.

proxy_country.description: Proxy country the request is sent from (ISO-2, e.g. 'US', 'DE'). Defaults to the country's site.

query.description: What to search, e.g. 'software engineer' or 'nurse'.

radius.description: Search radius in miles/km around the location.

start.description: 0-based result offset to start from. Default: 0.

name: indeed_jobs
title: Scrape Indeed job listings
